part.text:
The robot is in front of the green panel at the end of the corridor, and I've called rest. It's now crouched with the motors off.

The corridor ran straight ahead, then turned left, and the panel was at the end of that last stretch. The final sonar reading was about 0.66 m on the left and 0.25 m on the right. The right reading is probably the side wall, since the panel fills the camera view.
